title: Navalny solidarity picket outside the Russian Embassy
reason: The reported demand concerned Russian state repression and political freedom in Russia, so the target was a foreign government rather than Lithuania or Lithuanian policy.
notes: Executed picket, not merely an announcement. Attendance is described as about 100 by LRT and BNS/TV3, while 15min internally says both “several dozen” and “about one hundred”; the underlying LRT and TV3 reports share BNS material. The reported arrest was of a person who disrupted the picket, not a participant shown to have been detained for the demand. Excluded on target grounds regardless of the unresolved threshold wording.

title: Freedom Defenders’ Day local memorial and regional fire leads
reason: Available program and regional coverage describe commemoration, memorial fires, broadcasts or virtual activities; they do not establish an in-person public assembly of 50 or more with a demand directed at the Lithuanian state.
notes: Provisional screening exclusion, not a claim that no local activity occurred. Official schedule, regional preview and local city logistics page remain search-only; actual attendance, execution and any policy demand are unknown.

title: Nacionalinis susivienijimas statement on emergency powers
reason: The source describes a written statement to officials, not a public gathering.
notes: Organization publication only; no attendance or assembly evidence.

title: Nacionalinis susivienijimas statement on judicial reform
reason: The source describes a written statement sent to the president, parliamentary factions, the prime minister, and justice ministry, not a public gathering.
notes: The direct organization page dates its written statement January 12, 2021; the January issue bulletin describes it as distributed January 16. It was addressed to officials, not a public gathering. Its account of January 16 protest events refers to 2009, not a 2021 assembly.

title: January 13 at-home and institutional-window candle commemoration
reason: The opened report describes a commemorative candle initiative in residents’ and institutions’ windows; the figure of over 1,000 refers to educational institutions, not people assembled. No public crowd with a domestic policy demand is established.
notes: Distinct from the Lukiškės Square physical-action lead (E001), which is provisionally dated January 12 and retains separate threshold and demand-link questions. This exclusion is not an absence claim about every memorial activity.
